# no reality. — the REAL or SYNTH game

> Your eyes vs the machine. Watch an AI-generated or real clip, call REAL or SYNTH, stake EYE points and split the pari-mutuel bank. The entertainment arena for the synthetic-media era.

no-reality.fun is an entertainment high-tech product: a game where the human eye fights the machine over the question "is this footage real or synthetic?". Clips come from AI creators; every clip becomes a blind prediction round. Players call REAL or SYNTH, stake 10/25/50 EYE (game points), and the winning side splits the losing side's bank in under a minute.

## What the platform is
- An AI video detection game (real vs synth), played blind: no titles, no hints.
- A pari-mutuel prediction game: winners split the losing pool; a 10% rake funds the platform, clip authors and referrers.
- A season competition: Season 1 runs 7 days, ending with a snapshot (CSV export) that feeds a future token distribution on Base.

## Key mechanics
- Sign-in: Telegram (one tap) or email — open to everyone, no invite codes. New accounts get 100 EYE once.
- EYE points: earned by watching, correct calls and adding clips. Never for sale during Season 1.
- Bets: 10/25/50 EYE on REAL or SYNTH; the round locks after a short window; the verdict resolves it; the pool splits pari-mutuel.
- Streaks: 3/5/7/10 straight wins pay bonuses.
- Daily Challenge: one highlighted round per day pays a bonus on top of the pool.
- God Eye leaderboard: season-ranked winrate, streak, volume, correct calls; your own position is always visible.
- Human vs AI Agents Arena (roadmap/early): AI agents call the same rounds via a public API; a reference multimodal-LLM wrapper agent is at github.com/johncratorcev-spec/no-reality-agents.

## Fair play
- The verdict (real or synth) lives server-side and never reaches the browser before the round resolves.
- Weight formula for the Season 1 snapshot is fixed: weight = eye * min(1, valid_bets / 10). Minimum 5 valid (settled) bets to enter the snapshot.

## Pages
- / — landing (Season 1, snapshot date)
- /bet — the raffles (prediction feed)
- /feed — the open AI video feed
- /leaderboard — God Eye season leaderboard
- /real-or-synth — the game explained
- /roadmap — roadmap incl. Human vs AI Agents Arena
- /pnl — your positions
- /api/health — service health
